name: 窓口アプリと役割群を備える会話のメンバー帳
prompt:
Generate one faithful Japanese mobile conversation-members screen matching the native LH03-0155 preview. Keep the canvas exactly 390:580 and show only this members view, without status bar or bottom navigation.

Follow the native preview for exact Japanese wording, positions, hierarchy, spacing, and Lighthouse colors. At the top, show a magnifying-glass search row with 「会話内：一般」. Under it show the tabs 「メンバー」「メディア」「固定」「スレッド」, with メンバー selected in dark green and a short green underline. Below, show the white rounded invite row with the green people icon, 「メンバーを招待」 and a gray chevron.

In the light-gray section, show the heading 「質問・お問い合わせ — 1人」, then a white rounded app row: the simple green outline app icon, bold 「運営窓口」, a pale mint badge 「アプリ」 at the right, and the secondary phrase 「運営への質問はこちら」. This phrase is the hyperlink: render the entire phrase in a clear medium blue like the provided blue-link color reference. Do not color the rest of the app title or other labels blue.

Continue with the white member section headed 「奉仕チーム — 3人」 and exactly three rows:
1. pale mint avatar with 山; dark-green bold 「山田 はるか」; pale mint role pill 「受付」; gray subtext 「受付を担当します」
2. pale mint avatar with 佐; dark-green bold 「佐藤 ゆう」; no extra subtitle or role label
3. pale mint avatar with 田; dark-green bold 「田中 あおい」; pale mint role pill 「音楽」
Use thin light-gray row dividers and preserve the generous white member-card spacing shown in the preview. Keep text crisp, Meiryo-like, and sized like the native preview. Use clean flat surfaces, subtle rounding, and no shadows.

Do not add extra people, labels, icons, decorations, or app chrome. Names, tabs, headings, and role pills are not hyperlinks and keep their native green/dark colors; only 「運営への質問はこちら」 is blue. The original Discord screenshot provides source semantics, not layout or artwork. The native preview controls the final Japanese UI and geometry.

settings.hyperlinkText: 運営への質問はこちら

reviewNotes: 第1版を目視。見出し、3人の名前/役割、アプリ行とCTAを保持し、「運営への質問はこちら」だけを青く表示。native previewに対する主な残差は、アプリ行左のアイコンが人型イニシャルになりnativeの緑のアウトライン記号と異なること、下のメンバーカードがnativeより約15px早く終わり下余白が不足すること。needs-correctionで保持。所有者受入・ネイティブ編集・実動作は未検証。
reviewNotice: 画像生成候補。ネイティブ編集・実装・所有者承認とは別です。

inputReferences.role: Primary native Japanese preview: exact wording, 390x580 geometry, spacing, colors and member initials
Original Discord source screenshot: member groups and app/profile semantics; crop [0,70,390,580] in normalized-width-390 coordinates
User-directed hyperlink blue color reference only; do not copy its layout
